about: vt's application mutants (DOD track DT1 to DT3). A mutant of the program is judged by the example's laws and cases (scripts/examples vt); a mutant of the hand-Go control (cmd/ergo/testdata/vt/control, DT3) by TestVTAgreesWithControl, which plays the program and the control on 200 seeds. The rule of each names the law, the case or the test that kills it.

mutants.name: vtgap-csi-run-off
mutants.rule: A whole CSI in the ground state is taken in one loop, with no step of the machine (the events are the same: FastPathMatchesStep). Killed by test vt.FastPathsTakeNoSteps, the work counter.

mutants.name: vtgap-csi-run-last-param
mutants.from:
p.acc = acc
	p.parse = Parse{At: Ground, Counts: completed(k)}
mutants.to:
p.acc = 0
	p.parse = Parse{At: Ground, Counts: completed(k)}
mutants.rule: The CSI fast path completes the parameter being read, as the dispatch does. Killed by law vt.FastPathMatchesStep.

mutants.name: vtgap-csi-run-keeps-too-many
mutants.rule: The CSI fast path drops a sequence with more than MaxParams parameters, as the dispatch does. Killed by law vt.FastPathMatchesStep.

mutants.name: vtgap-csi-run-no-clamp
mutants.from:
acc = if v > MaxParam { MaxParam } else { v }
			digits = true
mutants.rule: The CSI fast path clamps a parameter to MaxParam, as the collector does. Killed by law vt.FastPathMatchesStep.

mutants.name: dt1-csi-param-colon
mutants.from:
case Digit, Colon, Semi:
			to(CsiParam, ParamByte)
mutants.to:
case Digit, Semi:
			to(CsiParam, ParamByte)
		case Colon:
			to(CsiIgnore, NoAct)
mutants.rule: In csi_param a colon is a parameter byte (a change to vt100.net, which sends it to csi_ignore), for SGR sub-parameters. Killed by law reference.StepMatchesTable.

mutants.name: dt1-class-sub-not-cancel
mutants.rule: SUB (0x1a) cancels a sequence from any state, as CAN does. Killed by law reference.StepMatchesTable.

mutants.name: dt1-params-unbounded
mutants.from: Counts{Params: if k.Params < MaxParams { k.Params + 1 } else { k.Params }, Inter: k.Inter, Digits: false}
mutants.to: Counts{Params: k.Params + 1, Inter: k.Inter, Digits: false}
mutants.rule: A separator past MaxParams parameters completes none, so the collector's array is never overrun. Killed by law Parser.ParamsStayBounded.

mutants.name: dt1-params-limit-low
mutants.rule: The parser keeps 24 parameters (an editor may send 17 in one SGR). Killed by law Parser.ParamsReachTheLimit, and by the cases.

mutants.name: dt1-intermediates-limit-low
mutants.from: Inter: if k.Inter < MaxIntermediates { k.Inter + 1 } else { k.Inter }
mutants.to: Inter: if k.Inter < 3 { k.Inter + 1 } else { k.Inter }
mutants.rule: The parser keeps 4 intermediates. Killed by law Parser.IntermediatesReachTheLimit, and by case vt/events-sequences.

mutants.name: dt1-fast-text-takes-backspace
mutants.rule: The fast path takes only printable ASCII; a control after text goes through the machine. Killed by law vt.FastPathMatchesStep.

mutants.name: dt1-fast-osc-takes-bel
mutants.rule: The OSC fast path stops at a control, so BEL still ends the string. Killed by law vt.FastPathMatchesStep.

mutants.name: dt1-utf8-reset-per-piece
mutants.rule: A UTF-8 character cut between two pieces is decoded whole: the decoder's state carries across Feed. Killed by law vt.SplitDoesNotMatter.

mutants.name: dt1-osc-unbounded
mutants.rule: An OSC string keeps at most OscLimit bytes and counts the rest. Killed by case vt/events-tally (osc-cut 156).

mutants.name: dt1-param-not-clamped
mutants.from: p.acc = if v > MaxParam { MaxParam } else { v }
mutants.rule: A parameter saturates at 65535, a u16. Killed by case vt/events-sequences (CSI 99999 C).

mutants.name: dt1-utf8-surrogate-accepted
mutants.rule: UTF-8 has no surrogates: ED A0 80 is three bad bytes. Killed by case vt/events-sequences.

mutants.name: dt1-colon-outside-sgr
mutants.rule: Only SGR takes colon sub-parameters; another CSI with one is dropped. Killed by case vt/events-sequences (CSI 4:3 H).

mutants.name: dt2-style-never-freed
mutants.rule: release gives the set its Release, so a style whose count falls to 0 leaves it (the set's own rule is dense's ReleaseThenReuse). Killed by law screen.StylesAreCounted.

mutants.name: dt2-pen-not-counted
mutants.rule: The pen holds a count on its style, so the style stays while the pen holds it. Killed by law screen.ScreenMatchesPlain: the next release of the pen's style is a dense defect (a Release with no holder).

mutants.name: dt2-styled-flag-missing
mutants.rule: A row with a styled cell is flagged, so clearing it releases its styles. Killed by law screen.StylesAreCounted.

mutants.name: dt2-clear-skips-release
mutants.rule: Clearing a styled row releases each cell's style (a dropped page too). Killed by law screen.StylesAreCounted.

mutants.name: dt2-history-limit-early
mutants.rule: The history keeps HistoryLimit lines and drops a page only past it. Killed by law screen.ScreenMatchesPlain.

mutants.name: dt2-ring-spare-pages
mutants.rule: The ring holds the history's pages, the buffer's and one, no more. Killed by law screen.ScrollbackIsBounded.

mutants.name: dt2-grow-every-push
mutants.rule: Once the ring is full, a line feed makes no cell: the oldest page is used again (a leak there shows as a counted growth guard). Killed by law screen.ScrollbackIsBounded.

mutants.name: dt2-print-pending-always
mutants.rule: With autowrap off, printing at the last column leaves no wrap pending. Killed by law screen.ScreenMatchesPlain.

mutants.name: dt2-split-misses-head
mutants.rule: Overwriting the head of a wide character blanks its tail. Killed by law screen.ScreenMatchesPlain.

mutants.name: dt2-shift-down-skips-top
mutants.rule: A scroll down moves every row of the region, the top one too. Killed by law screen.ScreenMatchesPlain.

mutants.name: dt2-free-id-stale-style
mutants.rule: A cell shows the style its id names (a reused id's new style is dense's ReleaseThenReuse). Killed by law screen.ScreenMatchesPlain.

mutants.name: dt2-reset-keeps-pen
mutants.rule: RIS resets the pen. Killed by law screen.ScreenMatchesPlain.

mutants.name: dt2-ich-keeps-orphans
mutants.rule: An insert that cuts a wide character blanks its other half. Killed by law screen.ScreenMatchesPlain.

mutants.name: dt2-cell-part-overlaps
mutants.rule: The part's bits lie above the 21 bits of the code point. Killed by law screen.CellFieldsRoundTrip.

mutants.name: dt2-width-first-wide
mutants.rule: U+1100, the first Hangul Jamo, is wide. Killed by law width.WidthTableMatchesRanges.

mutants.name: dt2-sgr-bright-off-by-one
mutants.rule: SGR 90 to 97 are palette colours 8 to 15. Killed by case vt/replay-gen.

mutants.name: dt2-form-feed-not-line-feed
mutants.rule: FF is a line feed, as LF and VT are. Killed by case vt/replay-gen.

mutants.name: dt2-history-two-pages
mutants.rule: A history too small for a page keeps one page. Both providers read HistoryPages, so they still agree; killed by law vt.Screen.HistoryDropsOldestPage, for screen.Screen and plain.Screen, borrow providers.

mutants.name: dt2-dch-keeps-orphans
mutants.rule: A delete that cuts a wide character blanks its other half. Killed by law screen.ScreenMatchesPlain.

mutants.name: dt2-erase-no-split
mutants.to:
let at = ri * s.cols
	for col in from..to {
mutants.rule: An erase that cuts a wide character blanks its other half. Killed by law screen.ScreenMatchesPlain.

mutants.name: dt3-control-tab-four
mutants.rule: The control's tab stops are every 8 columns, as the program's. Killed by TestVTAgreesWithControl (the control is checked by nothing else).

mutants.name: dt3-control-history-keeps-a-page-more
mutants.rule: The control drops the oldest page when the history passes its limit, as the program does; only the 1.5 MB seeds reach it. Killed by TestVTAgreesWithControl.

mutants.name: dt4-control-bright-bg
mutants.rule: SGR 100 to 107 are the bright backgrounds, palette 8 to 15, in the control as in the program; vt gen emits them since DT4. Killed by TestVTAgreesWithControl.

mutants.name: dt4-control-dcs-drop-after-complete
mutants.rule: A DCS hook is dropped when its complete parameters reach the limit before its final byte, not after completing the one being read (Ergo's enter reads the counts before the byte): a hook of 24 parameters is kept. vt gen emits one since DT4. Killed by TestVTAgreesWithControl.

mutants.name: vk1-flush-keeps-events
mutants.rule: Flush forgets the events it gave the screen: the next piece's events are given once. Killed by the replay cases.

mutants.name: vk1-clear-keeps-first
mutants.from: func Clear(p mut Stream) { p.out = p.out[0:0] }
mutants.to: func Clear(p mut Stream) { if len(p.out) > 0 { p.out = p.out[0:1] } }
mutants.rule: Clear forgets every event kept, not all but the first. Killed by the replay cases.

mutants.name: pacevt2-print-run-off
mutants.rule: Print recounts a run of cells of one old style once, not once per cell (the counts are the same: ScreenMatchesPlain). Killed by test screen.StyleRunsRecountOnce, the work counter.

mutants.name: pacevt2-clear-run-off
mutants.rule: clearRow releases a run of cells of one style once, not once per cell (the counts are the same: ScreenMatchesPlain). Killed by test screen.StyleRunsRecountOnce, the work counter.

mutants.name: pacevt2-print-retains-one
mutants.rule: Print retains the pen's style once for each cell that took it. Killed by the screen's laws (a style freed while cells hold it).

mutants.name: pacevt2-clear-releases-one
mutants.rule: clearRow releases a style once for each cell of the run. Killed by the screen's laws (a style kept after its cells are cleared).
